title: Native-harness reruns: second and third attempts for cells without a usable file
requested_by: Brando (chat, 11-16-2026): 're-run natively'; 'Let's have all results be consistent/clean'
rule: Each frozen condition says max_attempts 1. This amendment overrides that for listed cells only. A cell whose attempt 1 has no usable file (no candidate captured, an infrastructure interruption, or a failed content screen) gets attempt 2 under the identical frozen condition (same condition bytes, same runner bytes, same image, same allowlist) in a separate folder <root>_attempt2/; attempt 3, if needed, goes in <root>_attempt3/. At most 3 attempts per cell. The first attempt with a usable file is used; a cell with a usable attempt-1 file is never rerun. Every attempt's receipt is kept. If all 3 attempts fail, that agent's group is not applied and the reason is reported.

cells_known_at_recording.reason: Agent ran to Antigravity's own 1800 s print timeout (exit 3) without writing the output file.
Infrastructure interruption: after the 1800 s wall budget the docker exec client did not exit within 60 s (TimeoutExpired), so the runner removed the container before copying the file.

note: Six Grok V3 cells were still running when this was recorded; any of them without a usable file is added under the same rule.
